turns.q: Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, it can arrive completely gift-ready! You can select our signature gift packaging and add a personal gift message during checkout. Plus, our packing slips never display pricing or billing details.

As for shipping, orders typically leave our Toronto warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days for the US and Canada, or you can choose Express Shipping for 1 to 2 business day delivery within the US.

turns.q: Any discount if I add a second smaller item?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, absolutely! If you take advantage of any active Buy 1 Get 1 Free (B1G1) or tiered promotions by adding a second item, the system automatically pairs them up at checkout so the item of equal or lesser value is discounted. It is a great way to build a complete stacked look while saving! 🙂
